Solution 3 gives the bound $3t-4$, which I believe matches the published result on associated primes of powers of closed neighborhood ideals. Solutions 1 and 2 give $\lfloor(3t-1)/2\rfloor$ and $2t-1$, which I could not confirm. My confidence is limited because I did not fully verify either the upper bound or the sharpness example. The two-pentagon example in Solution 3 does have diameter 5, as stated.
